title: Resume data
description: Data read by render.js: all exports of data/index.js, each defined in a data/ file (named in its description). Fields marked "rich text" accept **bold** (highlighted keyword) and → (rendered as an arrow, read as an ASCII hyphen in the PDF text).

lang.description: File: settings.js. Language of the document (page lang attribute) and of the labels printed on the resume: section and sidebar titles, end of a current position. Data content is displayed as is.

showPrompt.description: Shows the "~ $ whoami" line above the name.

qr.description: QR code at the bottom of the sidebar, on every page. Absent, or without url: no QR code.

url.description: URL encoded in the QR code, which is generated at render time. The alt text is derived from it ("QR code en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dwight_Schrute").

label.description: Caption shown next to the QR code.

name.description: File: profile.js. Full name, main heading of the resume.

title.description: File: profile.js. Target job title, below the name. First ATS filter: reuse the job posting's title.

tag.description: File: profile.js. Short addition next to the title.

summary.description: File: profile.js. Profile paragraph below the header. Rich text.

contact.description: File: profile.js. Sidebar contact details, in display order.

href.description: Link (https:, mailto:, tel:). Without a link, the value is plain text.

accent.description: Shows the link in the accent color.

expertise.description: File: skills.js. Sidebar expertise, one line each. Rich text.

stack.description: File: skills.js. Sidebar technologies, by group.

level.description: Level shown to the right of the group.

items.description: Technologies in the group. A string, or an object with primary: true for a filled chip.

languages.description: File: skills.js. Spoken languages, with a gauge.

experience.description: File: experience.js. Experience section, most recent first. An entry is never split across two pages.

end.description: End date, as displayed. When absent (and current absent or false), only the start date is shown. Ignored if current is true.

current.description: Current position: filled node in the timeline, and the end date is replaced by "présent" (lang 'fr') or "present" (lang 'en'), even if end is set.

context.description: One sentence about the company or product. Rich text.

bullets.description: Achievements, one bullet each. Rich text.

education.description: File: education.js. Education section, most recent first.

items.description: Titles or specializations earned. A string (rich text), or a label with a subtle note.

url.description: Project link, displayed without https:// or www.
